scope: EU/EEA (ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC Art. 5(3) as implemented nationally) and the UK (PECR reg. 6)

rules.title: Google Analytics / Tag Manager loads before consent
rules.why: ePrivacy Art. 5(3) / UK PECR reg. 6 require consent BEFORE the _ga cookie is written; GA4 writes it on load.
rules.fix: type="text/plain" data-category="analytics" and let your CMP unblock it after opt-in

rules.title: Advertising pixel fires before consent
rules.why: Marketing pixels are never 'strictly necessary', so no consent means no lawful basis under Art. 5(3).
rules.fix: type="text/plain" data-category="marketing" and load it from the CMP callback

rules.title: Inline pixel snippet injects an ad tracker at parse time
rules.why: The copy-paste Meta/TikTok snippet builds its own <script> element, so blocking by tag attribute never sees it.
rules.fix: Wrap the whole snippet in your CMP's accepted callback, or park it as type="text/plain" data-category="marketing"

rules.title: Google Fonts hotlinked — the visitor's IP goes to Google
rules.why: LG Munchen I, 3 O 17493/20 (20 Jan 2022) awarded a visitor EUR 100 for exactly this embed.
rules.fix: Self-host the .woff2 files and serve them from your own origin

rules.title: YouTube embed uses the tracking domain
rules.why: youtube.com/embed drops VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on render; the nocookie host defers it.
rules.fix: Swap the host for youtube-nocookie.com, or click-to-load behind consent

rules.title: CAPTCHA script loads on page view, not on form use
rules.why: It is only necessary while the form is being submitted, not while the page is merely read.
rules.fix: Inject the script on first focus of the form, or gate it as data-category="functional"

rules.title: Session recorder starts before consent
rules.why: Replay tools capture keystrokes and can sweep in special-category data, so regulators treat them as high risk.
rules.fix: Start the recorder only from the CMP's accepted callback

rules.title: Google Maps iframe loads before consent
rules.why: The iframe contacts Google and transfers the IP address on page load, same as the Fonts case.
rules.fix: Show a static image placeholder and load the iframe on click, after consent

rules.title: preconnect opens a tracker connection before consent
rules.why: A preconnect completes a TLS handshake, so the visitor's IP reaches the tracker even if the script never runs.
rules.fix: Delete the hint, or add it from JS after consent is stored

rules.title: Inline script writes a tracking cookie
rules.why: Art. 5(3) covers any storage on the device, not just third-party scripts.
rules.fix: Move the write inside the consent callback

rules.title: Inline script stores a campaign identifier
rules.why: localStorage is 'information stored in the terminal equipment' under Art. 5(3), exactly like a cookie.
rules.fix: Write it only after the marketing category is accepted

rules.title: Script is parked as text/plain but carries no category attribute
rules.why: No CMP can ever unblock it, so the tag is dead rather than gated.
rules.fix: Add the data-category / data-cookieconsent attribute your CMP expects

rules.title: Trackers are present but no consent platform loads on this page
rules.why: Without a CMP nothing can ever be blocked or unblocked, so every tracker above runs unconditionally.
rules.fix: Add a CMP (Klaro, Cookiebot, Complianz, OneTrust...) and gate every tag listed here

rules.title: The consent banner loads after a tracker that is already running
rules.why: HTML executes top-down: a tag above the CMP has already fired by the time the banner is drawn.
rules.fix: Move the CMP loader above every third-party tag in <head>

rules.title: Google tag present without a Consent Mode v2 default state
rules.why: Since March 2024 Google requires ad_storage / analytics_storage / ad_user_data / ad_personalization defaults for EEA traffic.
